fields.title: [workflow-tools][remediation] Resolve test-cli/log-api/test-api dependency cycle blocking log extraction

fields.acceptance_criteria: 1. The repository-level dependency graph across the prospective  and  domain repo boundaries is re-mapped and shown acyclic (documented crate list per repo, with edges), replacing the current test-cli -> log-api -> test-api / log-api -> test-api cross-repo pair. 2. A chosen remediation strategy (from the candidates in the description, or an equivalent alternative) is documented with rationale and applied in the codebase -- the cross-repo cycle no longer exists in the resulting crate/dependency layout. 3. After remediation, test-cli, log-api, and test-api (and their existing consumers) continue to build (`cargo build -p test-cli -p log-api -p test-api`) and all existing tests for those crates continue to pass (`cargo test -p test-cli -p log-api -p test-api`), with no reduction in test coverage or removed test cases used to make the cycle disappear. 4. The instruction file .agents/instructions/engine/workflow-tool-extraction.instructions.md is updated to reflect the remediated (acyclic) dependency shape so the next extraction attempt does not re-discover the same cycle.
